---
name: Product issue
about: Define one outcome, its interface, and observable acceptance criteria.
---

## Outcome

<!-- What problem does this solve, and what becomes possible when it is done?
     Keep one independently deliverable outcome. State meaningful scope limits
     and link governing specifications or decisions where relevant. -->

## Interface

<!-- Name the caller or consumer and the component that owns the contract.
     Show the smallest useful interface: types/signatures, commands, a wire/data
     schema, or a link to an existing contract. Include relevant outputs,
     failures, side effects, identity and retry/recovery semantics.
     Describe the contract, not an internal algorithm or implementation plan.
     If unchanged, link the existing interface and identify the behavior being
     corrected. Call out unresolved decisions instead of inventing an API. -->

## Acceptance criteria

<!-- List observable conditions that establish the outcome and interface work.
     Cover the normal path and relevant failures, prohibited effects and recovery.
     State what must hold, not a checklist of implementation activities. -->
